deadline.value: Fall application deadline is April 1, 2027 on the graduate school's program page.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for admission, though it can support assistantship review.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for consideration of admission to the program; however, GRE scores can be used to support review for assistantships within the program

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required for admission, so no subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required for consideration of admission to the program; however, GRE scores can be used to support review for assistantships within the program

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree to advise before admission.

funding.value: All applicants are considered for assistantships; no guarantee is stated.
funding.quote: There is no specific financial aid application form; all applicants are considered for assistantships

entry_route.value: Most applicants hold an engineering M.S. first; a direct B.S.-to-Ph.D. track needs a 3.5 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold or expect to receive (by the enrollment date) a M.S. degree in an engineering discipline | The Department of Mechanical, Materials and Aerospace Engineering (MMAE) offers a direct track option from the bachelor of science (B.S.)

notes: Covers the Mechanical Engineering and Aerospace Engineering PhDs, which share the same MMAE admission rules.
name: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, PhD
